name: orbit-standing
description: Approved standing pixel astronaut. Background keyed out without redrawing: a flood fill from the image border removed only the flat background colour, so the visor and the outline are untouched. Silhouette, proportions, palette and pixel grid are unchanged.
processing: flood fill from the 1px image border through pixels within distance 26 of the background colour
crop to the figure bounding box plus 8 px
2 x 2 area average (exact 1/2 scale), colour weighted by coverage
24-colour median-cut palette snap without dithering (removes JPEG noise only)
render: image-rendering: pixelated; display at exact 1/2 (219 px) or 1/3 (146 px) height on the 1920 x 1080 stage
allowedMotion: whole-sprite translation (2-5 px), rotation up to 2 deg, opacity, shadow, surrounding light and particles
